_why: ONE set of cases, TWO evaluators. The editor's `wantHolds` (src/components/paramConditions.ts, driven by scripts/check_param_conditions.mjs) and the lab's `_want_holds` (backend/services/stress_tester.py, driven by backend/tests/test_param_gates.py) both answer these. They have already disagreed in silence once — a Custom fib level of 1.0 compared equal in Python and unequal in JS, and a toggle stayed live in the one configuration it exists to be dead in. A shape one side learns and the other does not now fails on the side that did not learn it.
_shape: actual = the value the param is sitting at; want = the right-hand side of one condition; holds = what both evaluators must answer.
